subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: In federal procurement terms, a situation where the need is compelling and urgent, but does not strictly involve an immediate physical threat to health or property, is often referred to as a(n):
questions.explain: Public Exigency is a condition requiring immediate action where delayed purchasing would result in serious financial or operational harm, distinct from an immediate physical emergency.
